Name: (CF) Cerri's animated Winter Star trees
Author: CerridwynMorgana
Description:
Four trees and two combinations of colours, blue/silver and red/gold.
  blue lights, silver balls
  silver lights, blue balls
  gold lights, red balls
  red lights, gold balls
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
One light strand dims while the other brightens.

Downloads.Description: Adds four new trees to the game, in blue/silver and red/gold combinations. One strand dims while the other brightens.

Manifest.Name: Cerri's animated Winter Star trees
Manifest.Description: Four Winter Star trees that have brightening and dimming light strings and decorative balls.
